name: Black moulded plastic hardware (acetal, glass-filled nylon)
kind: surface kind 13 in BOAT_CODE (new); M_BoatKit's BlackPlastic slot through the same lines
code: scripts/make_materials.py BOAT_CODE, the block between '// PLASTIC_WEAR >>>' and '// PLASTIC_WEAR <<<' (run when surf == 13); scripts/import_hardware_kit.py KIT_CODE copies it

boats.j22: hero J/22 slots BlackPlastic and CamBase (blocks, cam cleat bases, fairleads, clutches); MI_J22H_PackPlastic entries pick it up by Surface
boats.kit: M_BoatKit MI_Kit_BlackPlastic (27 kit parts: CamRiser, Fairlead, Block29/40, Ratchet57, FiddleCam, ClutchBank, Clutch, TrackCar, ...)
boats.berthed fleet: every boat with Age and Care (custom data 10 and 11)

levels_needed.L1: as new; one stray scuff on a part or two
levels_needed.L2: sun-facing faces chalked to a blotchy grey (L* about 29 on top, 23 on the sides), a little lake dust, edges rubbed back to black, scuffs
levels_needed.L3: as faded but wiped and treated: darker, even, satin; no dust or mildew; more scuffs
levels_needed.L4: heavy blotchy pale chalk (L* about 38 on top), tan dust in the hollows and on the tops, sparse dark mildew specks

drivers: chalk = timeK (0.25 + dirtK) x sky (0.5 + 0.5 n.z) x sun, blotch amplitude 0.4 + 1.2 dirtK, darker and satin with Care; dust = dirtK on up faces (and the kit sheet's cavities); polish = saturate(2 timeK) on sharp edges within 4 m; scuffs: a share of 1.5 cm cells growing with timeK and dirtK, within 4 m; mildew: dirtK over 0.6 and low Care. Age unset (-1): no change, as before.
replaces: black plastic was surface kind 0: one flat colour with no weathering at any age
maps: none: shader math only, Medium included; BOAT_CODE's detail-map block skips kind 13 (no gelcoat orange peel on plastic). M_BoatKit keeps its trim sheet
out_of_scope: rubber (kind 8: Rubrail, Rubber, ExtensionBlack) is the 'webbing/rubber' item on the texture list; white and red plastic, the outboard's painted black cowl (OutboardBlack) and the crew's buckles stay kind 0
